positions.title: Chief Product Officer
positions.description: Responsible for the product and design teams at KAYAK (NASDAQ: BKNG). Focusing on building the best travel meta search and corporate travel products with the help of artificial intelligence. Try out kayak.ai or talk to our enterprise team about testing KAYAK for Business.

positions.title: Chief Scientist & SVP, Technology
positions.description:
Additional responsibility for system architecture, KAYAK Labs (newly created team), and Engagement Marketing teams.

Spearheading GenAI efforts (internal & external). Design and implementation of passkeys support (first major consumer app to support passkeys). Closely collaborating with security & legal teams on web application security, compliance with data protection laws (GDPR, CCPA, ePrivacy, ...), and the implementation of a IAB TCF-compliant consent system.

positions.title: Chief Scientist & VP, Technology

Highlights:
• 2018 - KAYAK's iOS app showcased during Siri Shortcuts WWDC keynote introduction
• 2020 - KAYAK showcased as a first partner supporting "Upgrade to Sign in with Apple" during WWDC keynote presentation

positions.title: Chief Scientist
positions.description: Machine-learning, monetization, speed, and next-generation interfaces. Designed and implemented a multi-lingual natural language processing engine that powered integrations with Amazon Alexa, Facebook Messenger, and Slack. Collaborated with Amazon on launching hotel booking via voice.

positions.title: Security Architect
positions.description: Full 360 degree view on security posture. Highlights: Designed and implemented a centralized identity solution (ADFS, SAML) for internal applications, integrated a 2-factor security solution, hardened consumer-facing authentication systems, migrated all web pages from HTTP -> HTTPS, started a bug bounty program. Responsible for PCI DSS certification.

positions.title: Analytics Engineer

company.name: KAYAK
company.tagline: We are a leading travel search engine.
company.description:
At KAYAK, we help millions of travelers around the globe make confident travel decisions. We are a leading travel search engine. KAYAK searches other sites to show travelers the information they need to find the right flights, hotels, rental cars and vacation packages. 

And because we aim to help travelers explore the world more confidently, we’re always on the lookout for ways to make travel planning and trip management easier – offering up a variety of tools and features such as KAYAK Trips, Explore, Price Forecast and our constantly evolving app and A.I. innovations.

KAYAK is part of a global network that includes our sister brand OpenTable, as well as a portfolio of travel metasearch brands including Swoodoo, checkfelix, momondo, Cheapflights, Mundi and HotelsCombined. Collectively, we’re uniquely equipped to help people experience the world through travel and dining.

KAYAK is part of Booking Holdings Inc. and operates sites in more than 70 countries and territories. 

KAYAK will never request payment(s) from its candidates for open positions. If you have ever been contacted about a job at KAYAK by phone/Whatsapp or email, and have been asked to provide a Credit Card, wire transfer or crypto payment, please be aware that KAYAK is not associated with this outreach. If you receive a suspicious request regarding a career opportunity at KAYAK, please report it to us. 

To find out more, visit KAYAK.com.
